correctness.rationale: The exact moment formula follows from an absolutely convergent geometric series. At the rational angle the weighted evaluation map has rank L and kernel (z^L-1)R. For K<=L its coefficient norm is twice that of R. Analytic Gram Schur complementation makes the soft spectrum the squared projected first variation, whose conditional residue-class variance is L^4 p^L/(1-p^L)^2. This produces C times the positive K-by-K moment matrix. Discrete Fourier orthogonality yields the doubled-band explicit hard/soft spectra and sharp condition number. The standalone checker independently passed 768 finite assertions. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Semantic published-finding corpus searches and this record's prior Fourier-family ledger claims found no earlier assertion of the exact K-branch geometric-orbit rational-angle splitting. Zhedanov's full nine-page primary paper supplies moments, explicit OPUC norms, and the rational support limit, but not individual small eigenvalue coefficients, the K-dependent Toeplitz spectral law or the matched doubled-band condition number. Batenkov et al. and Kunis–Nagel prove bounds/scaling for finite clustered Vandermonde node sets under different hypotheses, not the weighted infinite-geometric orbit with exact limiting K-by-K spectrum. Analytic perturbation and variance calculations themselves are known methods and not claimed new. Residual priority risk remains.

value.rationale: Near a rational rotation, an infinite positive weighted sampling orbit loses precisely K Fourier polynomial directions at the first K over-resolution degrees. The theorem determines all their individually sharp stabilization constants and arithmetic dependence rather than merely a determinant or an order bound, then identifies a matched hard/soft spectrum and exact condition-number coefficient at doubled bandwidth. This provides meaningful structural sensitivity for Fourier moment reconstruction.
